scripts.build: npm run build -w @naviforge/host && npm run build -w @naviforge/extension
scripts.host: npm run build -w @naviforge/host && npm run start -w @naviforge/host
scripts.check: npm run build -w @naviforge/shared && npm run check -w @naviforge/policy && npm run check -w @naviforge/media-plane && npm run check -w @naviforge/extract && npm run build -w @naviforge/session && npm run check -w @naviforge/session && npm run check -w @naviforge/context-metrics && npm run check -w @naviforge/intake && npm run check -w @naviforge/observe && npm run check -w @naviforge/playbook && npm run check -w @naviforge/runtime && npm run check -w @naviforge/shared && npm run check -w @naviforge/host && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && bash scripts/check-trace-kind.sh && npm run check -w @naviforge/extension
scripts.test:live: npm run build -w @naviforge/extension && NAVIFORGE_LIVE=1 playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.test:live:bilibili: npm run build -w @naviforge/extension && NAVIFORGE_LIVE=1 NAVIFORGE_LIVE_SITES=bilibili-knowledge playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts
scripts.test:live:headed: npm run build -w @naviforge/extension && NAVIFORGE_LIVE=1 NAVIFORGE_HEADED=1 playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts
